chapter.verse: Ka gennop ah gamhluah cih pen na khempeuh a nei topa ahih hangin naupang ahih laisiah sila tawh kilamdang tuanlo hi.
A pa' sehsa hun a tun ma tengin nasem a encikte leh innsung thuvante' nuai-ah om hi.
Tua tawh kibangin eite zong i naupan hun lai-in leitung kipattah cilna thuciinte' sungah sila bang i hi hi.
Ahi zongin khanghun a kicin ciangin Pasian in numei' sungpan leh thukhun nuai-ah a suak dingin a Tapa hong sawlkhia hi.
Thukhun nuai-a om mite hong tatkhiat nading hi a, tanu tapa suahsakna i ngah theih nading ahi hi.
Tua hi a, tanu tapa na hihna uh hangin Pasian in “Abba! Pa aw!” a ci, ama' Tapa' Kha, eite' lungtang sungah hong sawl khin hi.
Tua hangin note pen sila hi nawnlo-in tanu tapa na hita uh a, tanu tapa na hih manun Pasian' hangin gamhluah na hi uh hi.
A beisa hun, Pasian na theih loh lai-un pianngeizia thu ah pasian ahilo nate' nuai-ah sila-in na om uh hi.

Ahi zongin tu-in note Pasian a thei khin, ahihkeileh zong Pasian in note hong thei khin, ahi kimlai a thazawm, kimanna neilo, kipattah cilna thuciinte lamah bang na cih uhleh kilehkik thei mawk na hi uh hiam? Tuate' kiangah sila suakkik nuam na hi uh hiam?
Nipikal sung nite, kum khat sunga khate, khuahun khenpite leh kumte, na tang tazen uh hi!
Note' tungtang ah ka hahkatna a mawknapi a suahkhak ding ka lunghimawh hi.
Sanggamte aw, no tawh a kibangin kong om mah bangin note zong kei tawh nong kibat ding uh kong thum hi. Kei' tungah nong khialh uh bangmah om lo hi.
A tuungin note' kiangah Lungdamna Thu kong tangkokhiat pen pumpi damlohna khat hang ahihlam na theih uh ahi hi.
Keima' pumpi omzia pen no' ading zia-etna khat suak napi kei nong neubawl tuankei uh a, zong nong nolh kei uh hi. Tua sangsikin Pasian' vanmi khat bang, Khris Jesu bangin nong sang uh hi.
Tua ahihleh na thupha ngahna uh koi ah om ahi hiam? A hang pen hua hun lai-in hithei hileh na mittang nangawn uh khelkhia-in kei hong piaknop lam uh teci kong pang hi.
Tua ahihleh thumaan thutak kong genna hangin na gal uh hita ka hi hiam?
Amaute in note hong kinbawl mahmah uh ahih hangin ngimna hoih tawh hilo hi. Amaute na kinbawl loh uh a phatmawh nadingin note hong hepkhiat sawm uh hizaw hi.
Ngimna hoih tawh hong kikinbawl pen thuhoih hi den a, tua pen note tawh kong om lai hun bek hilo hi.
Ka tanote aw, note' sungah Khris' pianzia hong kiphuh ma teng nausuah gimna nam ka thuakkik hi.
Note' hangin ka lungmang mahmah a, tu laitak no tawh hong om thei-in ka awsuah hong khel thei hi le-ing ka ut hi.
No, thukhun nuai a ut mite aw, hong gen dih un, thukhun thudon lo na hi uh hiam?
A hang pen Abraham in tapa nih nei-in khat pen sila numei tawh a neih, a dang khat pen tualmi suakta numei tawh a neih, ci-in kigelh hi.
Ahih hangin sila numei' tapa pen cilesa pana piang hi a, tualmi suakta numei' tapa ahihleh kamciam tungtawna piang ahi hi.
Tu-in hih thu, etsakna lim khatin la lehang: hih numei nihte pen thuciamna nam nihte cihna hi. Khat pen Sinai Mual pan hi a, sila a suak ding ta a nei Hagar ahi hi.
Hagar pen Arabia gam sunga Sinai Mual hi a, a tate tawh sila-in om ahih manin tu laitaka Jerusalem a kawk ahi hi.
Ahi zongin tunglama Jerusalem ahihleh a suakta hi a, tua pen eima' tunnu ahi hi.
Hih bangin zong kigelh hi: “Nausuaklo nupi ciing aw, gualnuam in; nang nausuak gimna a theilonu, puakzai-in kikokhia in! A hang pen pasal nei khat ii tate sangin a kinusianu' tate tamzaw hi.”
Tu-in sanggamte aw, note pen Isaac bangin kamciam tate na hi uh hi.
Ahih hangin tua hun lai-in cilesa pana piang tapa in Kha pana piang tapa a bawlsiat mah bangin tu-in zong tua bang mah ahi hi.
Ahi zongin Pasian' Laibu in bang gen ahi hiam? “Sila numei' tapa in tualmi suakta numei' tapa tawh gamh luahkhawm kha lo ding ahih manin sila numei leh a tapa hawlkhia in,” ci hi.
Tua ahih manin sanggamte aw, eite pen sila numei' tate hilo-in tualmi suakta numei' tate i hi hi.
